quickAnswer: İzmir Adnan Menderes Airport (ADB) lies 18 kilometers south of central İzmir in Gaziemir, operated by TAV Airports. Private road transfers reach İzmir city center in 25 minutes, Ephesus (Selçuk) in 55 minutes via the O-31 motorway, and Alaçatı in 60 minutes via the O-32 motorway, while the on-site İZBAN rail station links directly to downtown and Selçuk.

body.text: Serving both Aegean archaeological sites and the Çeşme peninsula, ADB is one of Türkiye's most efficient regional hubs. This izmir airport adb guide covers real highway transfer times, İZBAN commuter rail logistics, round-the-clock car hire counters, and direct European summer flight links.
How fast are transfers from ADB to Ephesus (55 min), Alaçatı (60 min) and İzmir center (25 min)?

By private car or taxi, İzmir Adnan Menderes Airport is 25 minutes from central Konak or Alsancak, 55 minutes from Ephesus and Selçuk via the Aydın motorway, and 60 minutes from Alaçatı via the Çeşme motorway. Expect 15 to 25 additional minutes during weekday İzmir rush hours or Friday evening Çeşme departures.

Operated by [TAV Airports](https://tavairports.com/izmir-adnan-menderes-airport), ADB sits directly beside the D550 corridor with fast access to both southern and western toll motorways. Havaş coaches also serve Alsancak, Urla, Alaçatı, Çeşme, and Kuşadası from the arrivals curb, as outlined in [2026 İzmir Airport ground transport listings](https://holidaycab.com/en/izmir/airport-to-city), though coach schedules add 30 to 45 minutes compared with door-to-door private cars.
How does the İZBAN commuter train work from the terminal?

The İZBAN commuter rail station connects directly to both Domestic and International terminals via a covered walkway with elevators and escalators. Trains run roughly every 10 to 20 minutes north to Alsancak and Karşıyaka in 30 minutes, and south toward Tepeköy for onward transfers to Selçuk near Ephesus.

Check live departure windows on the [official İZBAN timetables page](https://www.izban.com.tr/sayfalar/SeferSaatleri.aspx?MenuId=22) and route transfers on the [İZBAN network map](https://www.izban.com.tr/sayfalar/AgHaritasi.aspx?MenuId=97). Per the [İzmir Metropolitan Municipality Transportation Guide](https://www.izmir.bel.tr/en/transportation-guide/494/17), İZBAN uses distance-based pricing paid with an İzmirim Kart (sold at station kiosks) or contactless bank card. Tap your card both entering and exiting the turnstiles so the system refunds the maximum-distance deposit automatically.
Which car rental desks operate 24/7 at ADB?

Major international and Turkish car rental desks—including Avis, Budget, Enterprise, Europcar, Hertz, Sixt, Alamo, and Garenta—operate inside both the Domestic and International arrivals halls at ADB, with most primary counters staffed 24/7 or open to meet late-night flight arrivals when pre-booked with a flight number.
Because walk-up inventory drops sharply during July, August, and national holidays, follow this pickup checklist before driving out of Gaziemir:

items: Enter your flight number on the booking: Counters hold vehicles past midnight when tied to delayed landings.
Verify HGS toll-tag activation: Both the O-31 to Ephesus and the O-32 to Alaçatı use electronic HGS gantries with no cash booths.
Inspect vehicle glass and tires in the garage: ADB's multi-story car park is covered; photograph existing marks under bright lighting before exiting.
Confirm one-way drop-off rules: Returning an ADB car in Bodrum, Dalaman, or Istanbul carries a one-way relocation fee that must be quoted upfront.

body.text: Are direct European summer flights available?

Yes. Between late March and late October, İzmir Adnan Menderes Airport receives direct seasonal and year-round flights from major European hubs including London, Frankfurt, Munich, Düsseldorf, Amsterdam, Paris, Vienna, Zurich, Brussels, and Stockholm, operated by SunExpress, Turkish Airlines, Pegasus, Corendon, Lufthansa, and EasyJet.

Outside the peak April–October window, European connections thin primarily to German, Dutch, and UK diaspora routes, while Istanbul (IST and SAW) maintains frequent hourly domestic shuttles year-round. Travelers arriving on international flights who want expedited immigration can review [TAV Operation Services Meet & Greet at ADB](https://tavoperationservices.com/en-EN/services/meet-and-greet/izmir-adnan-menderes-airport) or verify live flight updates directly on the [İzmir Adnan Menderes Airport portal](https://izmirairport.com/en).

faq.q: Can I take the İZBAN train directly from İzmir Airport to Ephesus?
faq.a: Almost directly. Ride İZBAN south from Adnan Menderes Airport to Tepeköy station, then transfer across the platform to the connecting İZBAN train to Selçuk. From Selçuk station, Ephesus is a 10-minute taxi ride.

faq.q: Does Havaş run directly from ADB to Alaçatı?
faq.a: Yes. Havaş coaches depart from outside the Domestic and International arrivals halls directly to Alaçatı and Çeşme, running throughout the day in summer with reduced winter frequencies.

faq.q: How early do İZBAN trains start and stop at İzmir Airport?
faq.a: İZBAN services generally begin around 05:20 and conclude near midnight. For arrivals between 00:00 and 05:00, use ESHOT night bus 200/202/204, an airport taxi, or a pre-booked transfer.

faq.q: Is there an airport hotel attached to İzmir Adnan Menderes Airport?
faq.a: Yes. The TAV Airport Hotel sits inside the terminal complex, making it practical for late-night arrivals before an early morning drive to Ephesus or Çeşme.

faq.q: Are Domestic and International terminals connected indoors at ADB?
faq.a: Yes. The Domestic and International terminals sit adjacent to each other and connect via a short, covered walkway, taking roughly 5 to 8 minutes on foot.

faq.q: Do I need an International Driving Permit to rent a car at ADB?
faq.a: Visitors from countries whose licenses use the Latin alphabet can generally rent with their national driving license and passport, though carrying an International Driving Permit avoids desk disputes with local agencies.
